fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have been issued less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe haberse emitido hace menos de 10 años respecto a la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después de la fecha en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At French border control you may be asked to show proof of your travel insurance.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo francés se te puede pedir que muestres tu seguro de viaje.
entry.quote:
At French border control, you may be asked to:

- show proof of your travel insurance to demonstrate you can cover any emergency costs

entry.en: At the Schengen area you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo for short stays.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo o cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 euros o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.
entry.es: No puedes llevar carne, leche ni productos que las contengan a países de la UE.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in France.
safety.es: Es muy probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Francia.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in France.

safety.en: Thieves and pickpockets operate on the Paris Métro, on RER lines and at mainline stations.
safety.es: Ladrones y carteristas actúan en el metro de París, en las líneas RER y en las estaciones principales.
safety.quote: Thieves and pickpockets operate on the Paris Métro, on RER (train) lines and at mainline stations.

safety.en: There have been several cases of serious assault on RER line B.
safety.es: Ha habido varios casos de agresiones graves en la línea B del RER.
safety.quote: There have been several cases of serious assault on the RER line B

safety.en: Buy your own drinks and keep them in sight to avoid them being spiked.
safety.es: Compra tus propias bebidas y mantenlas a la vista para evitar que las adulteren.
safety.quote: Buy your own drinks and always keep them in sight to avoid them being spiked.

safety.en: Covering your face in public places in France is illegal.
safety.es: Cubrirse el rostro en lugares públicos en Francia es ilegal.
safety.quote: Covering your face in public places in France is illegal.

safety.en: The wildfire risk is highest in the south, particularly along the Mediterranean coast, in Corsica and parts of the south-west.
safety.es: El riesgo de incendios forestales es mayor en el sur, sobre todo en la costa mediterránea, Córcega y zonas del suroeste.
safety.quote: The risk is highest in the south of the country, particularly along the Mediterranean coast, in Corsica, and in areas of the south-west during periods of hot, dry weather.

health.en: Tap water is drinkable except in rare cases that are clearly signposted as not drinkable.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable salvo en casos raros que están claramente señalizados como no potable.
health.quote: Tap water (eau du robinet) is drinkable, except in rare cases such as in rural rest areas and sinks in railway carriage toilets

health.en: Other travellers are not covered by the French social security system and should have travel insurance covering medical costs.
health.es: Los demás viajeros no están cubiertos por la seguridad social francesa y deberían tener un seguro de viaje que cubra gastos médicos.
health.quote: Other travellers are not covered and will be billed the full price, even when at a public hospital; non-EU travellers should have travel insurance covering medical costs.

health.en: For a medical emergency, call 112 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Ante una emergencia médica, llama al 112 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Health risks in France include dengue, chikungunya and biting insects and ticks.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios en Francia incluyen dengue, chikungunya e insectos y garrapatas que pican.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in France, including:

- dengue

- chikungunya

- biting insects and ticks

health.en: Health care in France is of a very high standard.
health.es: La atención sanitaria en Francia es de un nivel muy alto.
health.quote: Health care in France is of a very high standard.

health.en: Pharmacies are marked by a green cross, usually in flashing neon or LED.
health.es: Las farmacias se identifican con una cruz verde, normalmente de neón o LED intermitente.
health.quote: Pharmacies are denoted by a green cross, usually in flashing neon (or LED).

help.en: The emergency number is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.
help.quote:
Telephone 112 (ambulance, fire, police)

Ambulance: 15

Fire: 18

Police: 17

help.en: The emergency number for deaf and hard of hearing people is 114 (SMS, chat, video and fax).
help.es: El número de emergencias para personas sordas o con problemas de audición es el 114 (SMS, chat, vídeo y fax).
help.quote: Deaf and hard of hearing emergency number (SMS, chat, video and fax): 114

getting_in.en: Roissy - Charles de Gaulle is the main international airport and likely your port of entry from outside Europe.
getting_in.es: Roissy - Charles de Gaulle es el principal aeropuerto internacional y probablemente tu puerto de entrada desde fuera de Europa.
getting_in.quote: The main international airport, Roissy - Charles de Gaulle (CDG IATA), is likely to be your port of entry if you fly into France from outside Europe.

getting_in.en: Many domestic and some internal European flights use Orly, the second Paris airport.
getting_in.es: Muchos vuelos nacionales y algunos europeos internos usan Orly, el segundo aeropuerto de París.
getting_in.quote: a lot of domestic flights, and also some internal European flights, use Orly (ORY IATA), the second Paris airport.

getting_in.en: Paris-Beauvais airport is about 80 km northwest of Paris, with buses to Paris provided by the airlines.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de París-Beauvais está a unos 80 km al noroeste de París y las aerolíneas ofrecen autobuses a París.
getting_in.quote: The Paris-Beauvais airport is situated about 80 km (50 mi) northwest of Paris. Buses to Paris are provided by the airlines.

getting_in.en: There are normally no immigration controls between Schengen countries, though they may be introduced temporarily.
getting_in.es: Normalmente no hay controles de inmigración entre países Schengen, aunque pueden aplicarse temporalmente.
getting_in.quote: There are normally no immigration controls between countries that have signed and implemented the treaty; there may be such controls temporarily, such as in connection with important events and various crises.

getting_in.en: French overseas departments and territories are not part of the Schengen Area and have separate immigration regimes.
getting_in.es: Los departamentos y territorios franceses de ultramar no forman parte de Schengen y tienen regímenes de inmigración distintos.
getting_in.quote: French overseas departments and territories are not part of the Schengen Area and operate separate immigration regimes from Metropolitan France.

getting_around.en: Most of the motorway network is made up of toll roads.
getting_around.es: La mayor parte de la red de autopistas es de peaje.
getting_around.quote: Most of the motorway (autoroute) network is made up of toll roads.

getting_around.en: If you lose your toll entrance ticket you will be charged for the longest possible distance.
getting_around.es: Si pierdes el ticket de entrada al peaje se te cobrará la distancia máxima posible.
getting_around.quote: Be careful not to lose your entrance ticket or you will be charged for the longest possible distance.

getting_around.en: It is illegal to use sat-nav devices or apps that detect speed cameras.
getting_around.es: Es ilegal usar navegadores GPS o aplicaciones que detecten radares.
getting_around.quote: It is illegal to use sat-nav devices (GPS) or apps that detect speed cameras.

getting_around.en: Virtually all rental cars have a manual gearbox.
getting_around.es: Prácticamente todos los coches de alquiler tienen cambio manual.
getting_around.quote: virtually all of the vehicles available for rent at the average car hire will be equipped with a manual gearbox.

getting_around.en: Domestic flights are limited by a ban on flights on routes reachable by train within 2.5 hours.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos nacionales están limitados por la prohibición en rutas alcanzables en tren en 2,5 horas.
getting_around.quote: due to ban on flights if a route is reachable by train within 2 1/2 hours, domestic flying remains a bookable option

getting_around.en: Blablacar rides cost about 8-10 euros per 100 km, below train and bus prices.
getting_around.es: Los viajes de Blablacar cuestan unos 8-10 euros por 100 km, menos que el tren y el autobús.
getting_around.quote: Prices for distances are below the ones of the train and buses, about €8-10 per 100 km.

money.quote: France uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Almost all stores, restaurants and hotels accept Visa, Mastercard and French CB debit cards.
money.es: Casi todas las tiendas, restaurantes y hoteles aceptan tarjetas de débito Visa, Mastercard y CB francesas.
money.quote: Almost all stores, restaurants and hotels accept debit cards from Visa, Mastercard, and French CB bank cards.

money.en: ATMs are by far the best way to get cash in France.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos son con diferencia la mejor forma de obtener efectivo en Francia.
money.quote: Automatic teller machines (ATMs; locally known as GABs, guichets automatiques bancaires) are by far the best way to get cash in France.

money.en: Tips are not expected because service is required by law to be included in menu prices.
money.es: No se espera propina porque la ley obliga a incluir el servicio en los precios del menú.
money.quote: Tips are not expected in France since the cost of service is required by law to included in menu prices.

money.en: Traveller's cheques are difficult to use and most merchants will not accept them.
money.es: Los cheques de viaje son difíciles de usar y la mayoría de comercios no los aceptan.
money.quote: Traveller's cheques are difficult to use – most merchants will not accept them

money.en: In general, shops will refuse transactions in foreign currency.
money.es: En general, las tiendas rechazan pagos en moneda extranjera.
money.quote: In general, shops will refuse transactions in foreign currency.

etiquette.en: Always greet the staff as soon as you enter a business establishment.
etiquette.es: Saluda siempre al personal en cuanto entres en un establecimiento.
etiquette.quote: Always greet the staff as soon as you enter a business establishment, not when you're ready to start talking.

etiquette.en: Use Monsieur for men and Madame for women with people you are not close to.
etiquette.es: Usa Monsieur para hombres y Madame para mujeres con quien no tengas confianza.
etiquette.quote: it is customary to use honorifics with people you are not close to or who are senior to you. Use Monsieur for men and Madame for women.

etiquette.en: Use tu with an adult only if that person indicates it is alright to do so.
etiquette.es: Usa tu con un adulto solo si esa persona indica que está bien hacerlo.
etiquette.quote: As a general rule, the only time you should use tu with an adult is if that person indicates it's alright to do so

etiquette.en: The French consider it very rude to be loud in a crowded indoor place such as a museum or restaurant.
etiquette.es: Los franceses consideran muy grosero hablar alto en lugares cerrados concurridos como museos o restaurantes.
etiquette.quote: The French consider it very rude to be loud in a crowded indoor place, such as a museum or restaurant

etiquette.en: To avoid a negative impression, avoid baseball caps, tracksuits, shorts (except in summer) and flip-flops (except at the beach).
etiquette.es: Para evitar mala impresión, evita gorras de béisbol, chándales, pantalones cortos (salvo en verano) y chanclas (salvo en la playa).
etiquette.quote: To avoid being seen in a negative light, you should avoid baseball caps, tracksuits, shorts (except in summer) and flip-flops (except at the beach).

etiquette.en: Everyone at public swimming pools is required by law to wear suitable swimming attire.
etiquette.es: En las piscinas públicas todo el mundo debe llevar por ley ropa de baño adecuada.
etiquette.quote: Everyone at public swimming pools is required by law to wear suitable swimming attire.

connectivity.en: France uses the GSM standard on the 900 and 1800 MHz bands.
connectivity.es: Francia usa el estándar GSM en las bandas de 900 y 1800 MHz.
connectivity.quote: France uses the GSM standard of cellular phones (900 MHz and 1800 MHz bands) used in most of the world outside of the U.S.

connectivity.en: Coverage is almost total but mobile use may be difficult in rural or mountainous areas.
connectivity.es: La cobertura es casi total, pero puede haber dificultades en zonas rurales o montañosas.
connectivity.quote: The country is almost totally covered but you may have difficulties using your mobile phone in rural or mountainous areas.

connectivity.en: A prepaid SIM has to be activated, usually online, and identification may be needed.
connectivity.es: Una SIM de prepago debe activarse, normalmente en línea, y puede requerirse identificación.
connectivity.quote: The SIM has to be activated, usually online. Identification may be needed.

connectivity.en: With an EU-based mobile subscription you should be able to use at least some of your bundle in France at no extra cost.
connectivity.es: Con una suscripción móvil de la UE deberías poder usar al menos parte de tu paquete en Francia sin coste extra.
connectivity.quote: If you have an existing subscription with an EU-based mobile provider, you should be able to use at least some of your bundled minutes, SMS, and data in France at no extra cost.

connectivity.en: Wi-fi is available in many trendy cafés in cities and towns.
connectivity.es: Hay wifi en muchos cafés de moda en ciudades y pueblos.
connectivity.quote: You'll also find wi-fi access (in cities and towns) in a lot of cafés usually those that are a bit trendy.

connectivity.en: To call a French number from abroad, dial the international prefix, 33 and the number without the leading 0.
connectivity.es: Para llamar a un número francés desde el extranjero, marca el prefijo internacional, 33 y el número sin el 0 inicial.
connectivity.quote: To call a French number from abroad, dial the international prefix + 33 + local number without the leading 0.
